zhExample: 雇主收到伤害通知后两周仍未付 TTD，也未说明拒付理由。林娜保留通知日期和银行记录，要求书面解释。
enExample: Two weeks after notice, no TTD or denial explanation arrives. Lina keeps the notice date and bank record and asks for written reasons.
currentQuestion: When is TTD paid?

enTitle: What are temporary partial disability (TPD) benefits?
zhSummary: 仍在康复、做较低收入的轻工作，直至恢复原工作或达到 MMI。
enSummary: TPD covers reduced earnings during light duty while healing, until regular work resumes or MMI is reached.
zhDetail: TPD 适用于仍在康复、能做轻工作但收入低于原岗位当前收入的员工，通常持续到恢复原工作或达到 MMI。它反映的是恢复期的收入差，不是永久工资差额。
enDetail: TPD is the benefit that may be received during the period in which an injured employee is still healing and is working light duty, on a part -time or full- time basis, and earning less than he or she would earn in the pre-injury employment. The employer pays TPD benefits to an injured employee until the employee has returned to his or her regular job or has reached maximum medical improvement.
zhExample: 林娜仍在理疗，只能做低薪库存登记。她可讨论 TPD；达到 MMI 后则要转向永久福利分析。
enExample: Lina is still in therapy and works a lower-paid inventory job. TPD may apply; after MMI the analysis shifts to permanent benefits.
currentQuestion: What are temporary partial disability (TPD) benefits?

enTitle: How is the TPD benefit calculated?
zhSummary: 2011 年 6 月 28 日后受伤，一般以原岗位当前周薪减轻工作税前周薪，再乘三分之二。
enSummary: For post-June 28, 2011 injuries, generally take two-thirds of the gap between current pre-injury-job pay and gross light-duty pay.
zhDetail: 2011 年 6 月 28 日及以后受伤的公式是：旧岗位当前周薪减去轻工作税前周薪，再取差额的三分之二。官方例子 $925 − $500 = $425，TPD 每周约 $283.33；更早伤害用轻工作净收入，计算规则不同。
enDetail: For injuries that occurred before June 28, 2011, the TPD benefit is two-thirds (66 2/3% ) of the difference between the average amount the employee would be able to earn in the pre-injury job(s) and the net amount he or she earns in the light-duty job. For injuries that occurred on or after June 28, 2011, the TPD benefit is two-thirds (66 2/3%) of the difference between the average amount the employee would be able to earn in the pre-injury job(s) and the gross amount he or she earns in the light-duty job. Example: An employee wa s earning $900/week at the time of injury. While the employee was off work and recuperating, the pay for the job increased to $925/week. The employee returns to a light -duty job and earns $500/week. Pre-injury average weekly wage (AWW) = $900 Current AWW of pre-injury job = $925 Post-injury gross pay = $500 Wage differential = $925 – $500 = $425 TPD = $425 X 66 2/3% = $283.33/week The minimums and maximums for TPD are available online at https://iwcc.illinois.gov/resources/benefits.html
zhExample: 旧岗位每周现值 $925，轻工作税前 $500。差额 $425 的三分之二约为 $283.33，这是手册的具体演算。
enExample: The old job currently pays $925 and light duty pays $500 gross. Two-thirds of the $425 gap is $283.33, the handbook’s example.
currentQuestion: How is the TPD benefit calculated?

enTitle: Who is eligible for the TPD benefit?
zhSummary: 手册将这一福利适用于 2006 年 2 月 1 日及之后发生的伤害。
enSummary: The handbook applies TPD to injuries occurring on or after February 1, 2006.
zhDetail: 手册把 TPD 福利适用于 2006 年 2 月 1 日或以后发生的伤害。先确认事故日期，再判断恢复期、轻工作限制及工资减少是否都成立。
enDetail: Individuals whose injuries occurred on or after February 1, 2006, are eligible to receive TPD benefits.
zhExample: 一名员工的事故发生于 2005 年。即使后来做了低薪轻工作，也先要核对 TPD 的生效日期门槛。
enExample: A worker was injured in 2005. Even with later lower-paid light duty, the TPD injury-date threshold must be checked.
currentQuestion: Who is eligible for the TPD benefit?

enTitle: What is vocational rehabilitation?
zhSummary: 可包含求职辅导、监督求职计划、再培训及教育。
enSummary: Vocational rehabilitation can include job-search counseling, supervised search, retraining, and education.
zhDetail: 职业康复不是单指“上课”。它可能包括求职指导、监督求职计划、工作技能培训或再训练，目标是让无法回原岗位的员工重新取得适合的工作。
enDetail: Vocational rehabilitation includes, but is not limited to, counseling for job searches, supervising a job search program, and vocational retraining, including education at an accredited learning institution.
zhExample: 林娜不能再搬重物，康复顾问安排技能评估、求职练习和电脑课程。它们共同构成职业康复，而非只是一节课。
enExample: Lina cannot lift heavily. Skills assessment, job-search coaching, and a computer course may all be parts of rehabilitation.
currentQuestion: What is vocational rehabilitation?

enTitle: When is the employee entitled to vocational rehabilitation?
zhSummary: 无法回原岗位时，合理必要的康复、培训与附带费用可能由雇主承担；员工也须合理配合。
enSummary: If the worker cannot return to the old job, necessary rehabilitation and training may be covered, with reasonable cooperation required.
zhDetail: 员工因工伤无法返回原工作时，必要的治疗、指导和训练及相关费用可能由雇主支付。员工应参与合理方案，记录求职、课程及限制；雇主和员工对方案有争议时由 IWCC 判断合理性。
enDetail: If the employee cannot return to the pre-injury job, the employer must pay for treatment, instruction, and training necessary for the physical, mental, and vocational rehabilitation of the employee, including all mainten ance costs and incidental expenses. The employee must co operate in a reasonable rehabilitation program. The employee may choose the provider of such reasonable vocational rehabilitation services or may accept the services of a provider selected by the employer.
zhExample: 新岗位需要电脑技能。林娜参加合理课程并保存出勤；雇主若质疑费用，双方可以让委员会审查计划。
enExample: A new role needs computer skills. Lina attends a reasonable course and saves attendance while the Commission can review a cost dispute.
currentQuestion: When is the employee entitled to vocational rehabilitation?

enTitle: What benefit is the employee entitled to while participating in an approved vocational rehabilitation program?
zhSummary: 核准康复计划期间可领取生活维持福利，并获支付相关附带费用。
enSummary: An approved rehabilitation program can carry maintenance benefits and incidental expenses.
zhDetail: 参加获认可的职业康复期间，员工可取得维持福利和康复附带的费用。保留计划、出勤与开支凭证，能说明福利与康复活动之间的联系。
enDetail: An employee is entitled to maintenance benefits, plus costs and expenses incidental to the vocational rehabilitation program.
zhExample: 林娜按计划上课并支付交通费。她保留课表和车票，帮助证明康复期间的维持福利及附带开支。
enExample: Lina attends classes and pays travel costs. She keeps the schedule and receipts to document maintenance and incidental expenses.
currentQuestion: What benefit is the employee entitled to while participating in an approved vocational rehabilitation program?

enTitle: How is the maintenance benefit calculated?
zhSummary: 维持福利不得低于该员工的 TTD 费率。
enSummary: Maintenance benefits cannot be less than the worker’s TTD rate.
zhDetail: 维持福利每周至少不能低于员工的 TTD 费率。先计算或核对 TTD 基础额，再看康复期间实际支付，不能把“参加培训”理解为没有收入支持。
enDetail: The maintenance benefit shall not be less than the employee’s TTD rate.
zhExample: 林娜原来 TTD 每周 $600。获认可的康复期间，维持福利不能低于这一周费率。
enExample: Lina’s TTD rate was $600 weekly. During qualifying rehabilitation, maintenance cannot be less than that rate.
currentQuestion: How is the maintenance benefit calculated?

enTitle: Who is eligible for the maintenance benefit?
zhSummary: 手册将资格适用于 2006 年 2 月 1 日及之后发生的伤害。
enSummary: The handbook applies maintenance eligibility to injuries on or after February 1, 2006.
zhDetail: 手册把维持福利资格与 2006 年 2 月 1 日或以后发生的伤害相联系。事故日期、获认可的康复安排和实际参与情况都需核对。
enDetail: Individuals whose injuries occurred on or after February 1, 2006, are eligible for the maintenance benefit.
zhExample: 另一名员工受伤于 2004 年。申请维持福利前，他要核对手册规定的事故日期门槛。
enExample: Another worker was injured in 2004. Before seeking maintenance, he checks the handbook’s injury-date threshold.
currentQuestion: Wh o is eligible for the maintenance benefit?

enTitle: What is permanent partial disability (PPD)?
zhSummary: 达到 MMI 后仍留下永久身体功能损失，但不一定完全不能工作，才进入 PPD 评估。
enSummary: PPD addresses permanent physical loss after MMI, even when the person can still work.
zhDetail: PPD 处理伤情达到 MMI 后仍留下的永久部分损伤或失用，而员工并非永久完全不能工作。评估的是稳定后的功能和收入影响，不是康复期每周停工福利的简单延续。
enDetail: PPD is: a) the complete or partial loss of a partof the body; or b) the complete or partial loss of use of a partof the body; or c) the partial loss of use of the body as a whole. “Loss of use” is not specifically defined in the law, but it generally means the employee is unable to do things he or she was able to do before the injury. The Commission cannot make a PPD determination until the employee has reached maximum medical improvementor “MMI.” PPD is paid only if the job- related injury results in some permanent physical loss.
zhExample: 林娜治疗结束后能继续工作，却永远无法完全抬高左臂。MMI 后的这项持续功能损失可能进入 PPD 评估。
enExample: After treatment, Lina can work but cannot fully raise her left arm. That lasting post-MMI loss may enter a PPD assessment.
currentQuestion: What is permanent partial disability (PPD)?

enTitle: What types of PPD benefits are awarded by the Commission?
zhSummary: 工资差额、法定身体部位表、整体身体损失、永久容貌损害；同一损失不能重复领取互斥项目。
enSummary: The four paths are wage differential, scheduled body part, person-as-a-whole, and disfigurement, with limits on double recovery.
zhDetail: 手册列四种 PPD。①工资差额：因伤改做低薪工作，按旧岗位当前收入与新收入差额的三分之二给付；手册例子是 $1,040−$500=$540，每周福利 $360。2011 年 9 月 1 日前的伤害按旧规则可终身支付；之后的伤害按裁决后五年或到 67 岁取较晚者。②法定部位表：AWW 的 60% 乘该部位法定周数，再乘失用比例；$500 周薪、拇指 10% 失用、76 周的例子为 $2,280。③非表列整体身体：以 500 周为基础；同样 $500 周薪、背部整体身体 10% 失用的例子为 $15,000。④严重永久容貌损害：适用部位和最高 162 周限制；疤痕至少愈合六个月后才可评估。同一伤害不能同时领工资差额和永久失能，或对同一部位同时领失用与容貌损害。
enDetail: There are four types of PPD benefits: a. Wage differential (Section 8(d)(1) of Workers’ Compensation Act) If, due to the injury, the employee obtains a new job that pays less than the pre-injury employment, he or she may be entitled to receive a wage differential award. The wage differential award is two-thirds (66 2/3%) of the difference between the amount the employee earns in the new job and the amount he or she would be earning in their prior employment. For injuries that occur before September 1, 2011, benefits shall be paid for the life of the employee. For injuries that occur on or after September 1, 2011, benefits shall be paid for five years after the date of the award or until the employee reaches age 67, whichever is later. An employee may be compensated for either the loss of wages or the permanent disability related to the same injury, but not both. Example: An employee was earning $1,000/week at the time of injury. While the employee was off work and recuperating, the pay for the job increased to $1,040/week. Due to the injury, the employee can only find a job that pays $500/week. Pre-injury average weekly wage (AWW) = $1,000 Current AWW of pre-injury job = $1,040 AWW of post-injury job = $500 Wage differential = $1,040 - $500 = $540 PPD benefit = $540 X 66 2/3% = $360/week b. Schedule of injuries (Section 8(e) of Workers’ Compensation Act) The Act sets a value on certain body parts, expressed as a number of weeks of compensation for each part. (See the chart at the end of this section). The number of weeks is then multiplied by 60% of the employee’s AWW. If a body part is amputated or if it cannot be used at all, that represents a 100% loss, and the employee is awarded the entire number of weeks listed on the chart. If the employee sustains a partial loss, the benefit is calculated by multiplying the percentage of loss by the number of weeks listed. Example: An employee earning $500 per week injures his or her thumb, and it is later determined there is a 10% loss of the use of the thumb. PPD weekly rate = $500 X 60% = $300 Number of weeks = 76 weeks X 10% = 7.6 PPD benefit = 7.6 weeks X $300 = $2,280 c. Non-schedule injuries (person as a whole) (Section 8(d)2) If the condition is not listed on the schedule of injuries, but it imposes certain limitations, the employee may be entitled to a percentage of 500 weeks of benefits, based on the loss of the person as a whole. The number of weeks is then multiplied times 60% of the employee’s AWW. Example: An employee earning $500/week suffers a back injury that is determined to have caused a 10% loss of the person as a whole. PPD weekly rate = $500 X 60% = $300 Number of weeks = 500 weeks X 10% = 50 weeks PPD benefit = 50 weeks X $300 = $15,000 d. Disfigurement (Section 8(c) of Workers’ Compensation Act) An employee who suffers a serious and permanent disfigurement to the head, face, neck, chest above the armpits, arm, hand, or leg below the knee, is entitled to a maximum of 162 weeks of benefits at the PPD rate. The number of weeks is then multiplied by 60% of the employee’s AWW. A scar must heal for at least six months before a hearing to assess the disfigurement can be held. An employee may not collect compensation for disfigurement and the loss of use for the same body part. For example, a person who undergoes carpal tunnel surgery and is found to have experienced some loss of use, may be awarded a benefit based on the body part or on the disfigurement from the surgery scars, but not both.
zhExample: 林娜无法回原岗位但找到低薪工作；另一名员工则失去拇指部分功能。前者可能看工资差额，后者可能看部位表，计算路不同。
enExample: Lina takes a lower-paid job; another worker loses thumb function. The first may involve wage differential, the second the schedule.
currentQuestion: W hat types of PPD benefits are awarded by the Commission?

enTitle: How is the level of disability assessed?
zhSummary: 现行手册列医生损伤报告、职业、年龄、未来赚钱能力、治疗记录等因素，单一因素不应独断。
enSummary: The current handbook lists impairment report, occupation, age, earning capacity, and medical evidence; no single factor alone decides the result.
zhDetail: 2011 年 9 月 1 日前的伤害，委员会评估身体损伤及其对个人生活的影响，可考虑年龄、技能、职业、训练、活动能力、疼痛、僵硬和活动范围。该日期及以后伤害，手册列五个因素：医生依据最新版 AMA 评估指南所作损伤报告、职业、受伤时年龄、未来收入能力、以及治疗病历佐证的失能证据。任何单一因素都不能独自决定结果；仲裁员应在决定中解释采用因素的相关性与权重。
enDetail: For injuries occurring before September 1, 2011, the Commission evaluates the physical impairment and the effectof the disability on the injured employee’s life. Factors that may be considered include the individual's age, skill, occupation, training, ability to engage in certain kinds of activities, pain, stiffness, or limitation of motion. For injuries occurring on or after September 1, 2011, the Commission bases the determination of disability on five factors: (1) an impairment report prepared by a physician using the most current edition of the American Medical Association's “Guides to the Evaluation of Permanent Impairment.” (2) the occupation of the injured employee; (3) the age of the employee at the time of the injury; (4) the employee’s future earning capacity; and (5) evidence of disability corroborated by the treating medical records. One of these factors may not be the sole determinantof disability. The relevance and weightof any factors used in addition to the level of impairment as reported by the physician must be explained by the arbitrator in the decision.
zhExample: 医生评林娜失用 10%。仲裁员还要看她的职业、年龄、未来收入和病历，不是直接把“10%”当最终裁决。
enExample: A doctor rates Lina at 10%. The arbitrator also considers her occupation, age, future earnings, and records, not the number alone.
currentQuestion: How is the level of disability assessed?

enTitle: Is an employee eligible for compensation for pain and suffering for a work-related injury?
zhSummary: 工伤法通常不另付过去的痛苦损失；残余疼痛可作为永久失能的一部分考虑。
enSummary: The Act does not separately pay past pain and suffering; residual pain can factor into permanent disability.
zhDetail: 工伤制度一般不另赔过去的痛苦与精神损害；若残余疼痛反映永久功能障碍，它可以进入失能程度分析。需用持续症状、治疗记录和工作能力变化说明影响。
enDetail: Employees are not compensated for past pain and suffering, only for the residual pain that is partof the permanent disability.
zhExample: 林娜手术后仍在抬臂时疼痛。过去经历的痛苦不另列赔偿；持续疼痛可作为功能影响证据。
enExample: Lina still has pain raising her arm after surgery. Past suffering is not a separate award; lasting pain may bear on function.
currentQuestion: Is an employee eligible for compensation for pain and suffering for a work-related injury?

enTitle: What if the employee’s condition changes?
zhSummary: 部分 PPD 裁决可在法定窗口内请求调整；工资差额和其他类别的窗口不同。
enSummary: Some PPD awards can be modified within statutory windows, which differ for wage differential and other categories.
zhDetail: 最终 PPD 裁决后，身体状况确有变化时，某些裁决可在法定窗口请求调整：手册对符合条件的工资差额裁决说明 60 个月，对其他 PPD 类型通常说明 30 个月。和解通常更难重新打开，先核对文书类型。
enDetail: For wage differential benefits where the injury occurred on or after February 1, 2006, if the employee’s physical condition changes during the 60 months after the award becomes final, either party may ask the Commission to adjust the award. For all other PPD categories: if the employee’s physical condition changes during the 30 months after the award becomes final, either party may ask the Commission to adjust the award. enExample: Two years after a PPD award, Lina’s shoulder worsens. She checks the award type and final date against the 30- or 60-month window.

enTitle: What is permanent total disability (PTD)?
zhSummary: 可能是两处列明部位完全失用，或永久无法从事存在稳定就业市场的工作。
enSummary: PTD can mean complete loss of two listed body parts or permanent inability to perform work in a reasonably stable labor market.
zhDetail: PTD 可源于法定列举的双肢或双眼等重大失用，也可因伤情使员工无法在稳定劳动力市场从事任何工作。不是只看原岗位做不了；需要评估整体可就业能力。
enDetail: PTD is either: a) The permanent and complete loss of use of both hands, both arms, both feet, both legs, botheyes, or any two such parts, e.g., one leg and one arm; or b) A complete disability that renders the employee permanently unable to do any kind of work for which there is a reasonably stable employment market.
zhExample: 周先生无法回原工厂，但能稳定做办公室工作，这不必然是 PTD；若任何稳定工作都无法维持，判断才不同。
enExample: Mr. Zhou cannot return to the plant but can sustain office work; that does not automatically mean PTD. Inability to sustain any work changes the analysis.
currentQuestion: What is permanent total disability (PTD)?

enTitle: What is the PTD benefit?
zhSummary: 每周基本为 AWW 的三分之二，受当期上下限约束，符合条件可长期支付。
enSummary: The basic weekly benefit is two-thirds of AWW, subject to current limits, and may continue for life.
zhDetail: PTD 周福利通常为 AWW 的三分之二，并受事故日期对应的最低、最高额限制。符合资格时可能持续支付；实际金额还会受后续变化及法律规则影响。
enDetail: A claimant who is found to be permanently and totally disabled is entitled to a weekly benefit equal to two-thirds (66 2/3%) of his or her average weekly wage, subject to minimum and maximum limits, for life. The minimums and maximums for PTD benefits are available in Commission offices and online at https://iwcc.illinois.gov/resources/benefits.html
zhExample: 周先生 AWW 为 $900，三分之二基础额为 $600 每周；最终仍须核对 PTD 的最低和最高额。
enExample: Mr. Zhou’s AWW is $900, giving a $600 weekly base at two-thirds, subject to PTD limits.
currentQuestion: What is the PTD benefit?

enTitle: Can a PTD recipient ever work?
zhSummary: 若实际或能够重新工作，雇主可申请终止或修改 PTD，不能假定福利绝对不变。
enSummary: If the worker returns or can return to work, the employer may seek modification or termination.
zhDetail: 若领取 PTD 的员工后来实际恢复工作能力，福利可能被修改或终止。不能仅因出现一项收入或一次活动就自动下结论；应核实持续劳动能力与裁决条件。
enDetail: If an employee experiences a complete disability that renders the employee permanently unable to do any kind of work, and returns to work or is able to return to work, the employer may petition the Commission to terminate or modify the PTD benefit.
zhExample: 周先生后来恢复部分工作能力。付款方不能只看他偶尔帮忙一次，就断定能长期稳定工作；需看实际持续能力。
enExample: Mr. Zhou later improves. One occasional activity does not establish sustained capacity to work; the actual lasting ability matters.
currentQuestion: Can a PTD recipient ever work?

enTitle: Does the PTD benefit amount stay fixed for life?
zhSummary: 仲裁裁决的受益人可能从费率调整基金获得法定生活成本调整。
enSummary: An arbitrated award may qualify for cost-of-living payments from the Rate Adjustment Fund.
zhDetail: 由仲裁裁决确立的 PTD 可适用手册说明的生活费调整机制。调整起点、基金与支付安排随裁决和法律而定，应查看裁决文件及现行 IWCC 资料。
enDetail: If a case is decided by an arbitrator, an employee will be entitled to cost -of-living adjustments. Beginning on the second July 15th after the award became final, the recipient will receive a cost-of- living payment from the Commission’s Rate Adjustment Fund that reflects the increase in the statewide average weekly wage during the preceding year. These payments are made monthly.
zhExample: 周先生依仲裁裁决领取 PTD，多年后核对生活费调整。他查看裁决日期和适用基金规则，而非自己估一个通胀率。
enExample: Mr. Zhou receives PTD under an award and later checks cost-of-living adjustments against the award date and applicable fund rules.
currentQuestion: D oes the PTD benefit amount stay fixed for life?

enTitle: Can an employee receive both PTD and Social Security?
zhSummary: 符合两套计划条件时可以，但社会保障福利可能因抵扣规则减少。
enSummary: Both may be available if independently eligible, although Social Security can apply an offset.
zhDetail: 符合各自计划条件的员工可能同时领取 PTD 与社会保障残疾福利，但社会保障金额可能因工伤福利而被抵减。两套制度由不同机关管理，须分别核对资格和计算。
enDetail: Yes, if the employee qualifies under the terms of each program. If an employee receives both benefits, the Social Security Administration will apply a formula that may result in a reduction in the Social Security benefit.
zhExample: 周先生同时符合社会保障残疾福利条件。他向两个体系分别核对资格，并注意社会保障可能抵减。
enExample: Mr. Zhou also qualifies for Social Security disability. He checks both programs separately and accounts for a possible offset.
currentQuestion: C an an employee receive both PTD and Social Security?

enTitle: What is the burial benefit?
zhSummary: 手册区分历史受伤日期，2006 年 2 月 1 日后致死伤害列为 8,000 美元；核对适用日期。
enSummary: The handbook distinguishes injury dates; it lists $8,000 for fatal injuries after February 1, 2006, subject to date-specific law.
zhDetail: 手册按伤害日期区分丧葬费：2006 年 2 月 1 日前为 $4,200，之后为 $8,000。先确定导致死亡的工伤发生日期，再核对最新法条与付款记录；丧葬费与遗属周福利是不同项目。
enDetail: For injuries resulting in death that occurred before February 1, 2006, a benefitof $4,200 is provided to the survivor or the person paying for the burial. For injuries resulting in death occurring after February 1, 2006, the benefit is $8,000.
zhExample: 陈先生的工伤事故发生在 2012 年，后导致死亡。家属按事故日期核对丧葬费档次，而不是按领取申请的年份猜。
enExample: Mr. Chen’s fatal injury occurred in 2012. His family checks burial payment using the injury date, not the year they apply.
currentQuestion: What is the burial benefit?

enTitle: How is the amount of the survivors’ benefit calculated?
zhSummary: 基础为死者受伤前 52 周税前 AWW 的三分之二，并受当期上下限约束。
enSummary: The basic survivor rate is two-thirds of gross AWW over the 52 weeks before injury, subject to current limits.
zhDetail: 遗属周福利通常以死者受伤前 52 周税前 AWW 的三分之二为基础，再受法定上下限与期限规则约束。需保存工资记录及受益人资格材料，不能仅按最后一张工资单估算。
enDetail: The benefit is two-thirds (66 2/3%) of the employee’s gross average weekly wage during the 52 weeks before the injury, subject to minimum and maximum limits. The minimums and maximums for the survivors’ benefit are available online at https://iwcc.illinois.gov/resources/raf.html
zhExample: 陈家整理死者过去 52 周工资记录，用 AWW 计算遗属周福利基础额，再核对法定上下限。
enExample: The Chen family gathers 52 weeks of pay to calculate the survivors’ weekly base and check legal limits.
currentQuestion: H ow is the amount of the survivors’ benefit calculated?

enTitle: Who is entitled to the survivors’ benefit?
zhSummary: 配偶及未成年子女优先；没有时再看完全依赖的父母及达到规定依赖程度者。
enSummary: Spouse and children under 18 are primary; dependent parents and others may qualify when no primary beneficiary exists.
zhDetail: 配偶与未满 18 岁子女是主要受益人；没有第一顺位时，再按规则考虑完全依赖的父母及符合依赖比例的其他人。证明经济依赖需要事实材料，亲属关系本身并不总是足够。
enDetail: The primary beneficiaries of the survivors’ benefit are the spouse and children under the age of 18. If no primary beneficiaries exist, benefits may be paid to totally dependent parents. If no totally dependent parents exist, benefits may be paid to persons who were at least 50% dependenton the employee at the time of death.
zhExample: 陈先生留下配偶和 12 岁女儿。她们处于主要受益人顺位；其他亲属不能只凭亲属关系排在前面。
enExample: Mr. Chen leaves a spouse and 12-year-old daughter. They are primary beneficiaries; kinship alone does not put others ahead.
currentQuestion: Who is entitled to the survivors’ benefit?

enTitle: If the surviving spouse remarries, does this have an effect on eligibility for survivors’ benefits?
zhSummary: 有合资格子女时福利继续；没有时，配偶可获相当两年福利的最后一次付款。
enSummary: Benefits continue if eligible children remain; otherwise a remarried spouse receives a final lump sum equal to two years of compensation.
zhDetail: 配偶再婚时若仍有合资格子女，遗属福利继续。若没有合资格子女，手册说明配偶可领取相当于两年福利的最后一次给付，随后其权利终结。要结合具体家庭结构判断。
enDetail: If there are eligible children at the time of remarriage, benefits will continue. If there are no eligible children at the time of remarriage, the spouse is entitled to a final lump sum payment equal to two years of compensation. All rights tofurther benefits are extinguished.
zhExample: 几年后配偶再婚，女儿仍未成年，福利继续。若没有合资格子女，再婚的给付路径会不同。
enExample: Years later the spouse remarries while the daughter is still a minor, so benefits continue. Without an eligible child, the path differs.
currentQuestion: If th e surviving spouse remarries, does this have an effect on eligibility for survivors’ benefits?

enTitle: Does the benefit amount stay fixed for life?
zhSummary: 仲裁裁决的遗属福利可能获费率调整基金支付的生活成本调整。
enSummary: Survivors under an arbitrated award may receive Rate Adjustment Fund cost-of-living payments.
zhDetail: 由仲裁裁决确立的遗属福利可有生活费调整。受益人应查看裁决、支付记录和 IWCC 当前调整说明，确认起始时间及金额；它不是每年自动按任意通胀率增加。
enDetail: If a case is decided by an arbitrator, recipients of the survivors’ benefit will be entitled to cost-of-living adjustments. Beginning on the second July 15th after the award became final, the recipient will receive an amount from the Commission’s Rate Adjustment Fund that reflects the increase in the statewide average weekly wage during the preceding year. These payments are made monthly.
zhExample: 陈家持有仲裁裁决，想知道周福利是否调整。他们根据裁决日期和 IWCC 当前规则核算，而非自动加一个固定百分比。
enExample: The family has an arbitrator’s award and asks about adjustments. They check the award date and current IWCC rules instead of assuming a fixed increase.
currentQuestion: D oes the benefit amount stay fixed for life?
